# Red-flag checks

The 13 checks behind the Red flags tab (B01 §5). Each one is OK, Watch, Concern, Not available or Not applicable, with one plain sentence and the pages it used. The checks describe the document; they never say what to do about it.

Thresholds version: `b01-initial-1` (stored in every `redflags.json`). Missing data: "FinSight couldn't find this in the document."

| Check | Title | How this check works | Thresholds |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| RF01 | Profit or loss | Watch if the latest year shows a loss. Concern if each of the last 3 years shows a loss. | — |
| RF02 | Cash from the business | Watch if the business used more cash than it brought in last year. Concern if that happened in 2 or more of the last 3 years. | `concern_negative_years` = 2 |
| RF03 | Debt | Total borrowings divided by net worth. Watch above 1.0, Concern above 2.0. Not used for lenders. | `watch_above` = 1.0, `concern_above` = 2.0 |
| RF04 | Who gets the IPO money | The share of the IPO that goes to existing shareholders who are selling. Watch above 50%, Concern above 80%. | `watch_above_pct` = 50, `concern_above_pct` = 80 |
| RF05 | What insiders paid | The IPO price divided by the average price selling shareholders paid. Watch at 5 times or more, Concern at 20 times or more. | `watch_at_least` = 5, `concern_at_least` = 20 |
| RF06 | Founders' stake after the IPO | Promoter and promoter group holding after the IPO. Watch below 40%, Concern below 25% or when there is no identifiable promoter. | `watch_below_pct` = 40, `concern_below_pct` = 25 |
| RF07 | Vague use of money | The share of the new money set aside for general purposes or acquisitions not yet named. Watch above 20%, Concern at 30% or more. | `watch_above_pct` = 20, `concern_at_least_pct` = 30 |
| RF08 | Court cases | Watch if there is any criminal case involving the company, promoters or directors. Concern if the amounts in dispute are more than 10% of net worth. | `concern_above_pct_of_net_worth` = 10 |
| RF09 | Dealings with related companies | Business with related parties as a share of revenue. Watch above 10%, Concern above 25%. | `watch_above_pct` = 10, `concern_above_pct` = 25 |
| RF10 | Dependence on a few customers | Watch if the top 10 customers bring in more than 50% of revenue or the top customer more than 20%. Concern if the top customer brings in more than 40%. | `watch_top10_above_pct` = 50, `watch_top1_above_pct` = 20, `concern_top1_above_pct` = 40 |
| RF11 | Price compared with listed peers | The P/E at the IPO price compared with the median P/E of the listed peers the document names. Watch above 1.5 times the median, Concern above 2.5 times. | `watch_above_x` = 1.5, `concern_above_x` = 2.5 |
| RF12 | Auditor's remarks | Watch if the auditor adds an emphasis of matter or a CARO remark. Concern if the auditor gives a qualified opinion. | — |
| RF13 | Pledged promoter shares | The share of promoter shares pledged as security for loans. Watch for any pledge, Concern above 10%. | `concern_above_pct` = 10 |
